title: No Szöllősi matrix lies in a quadruplet of mutually unbiased bases in dimension six
description: Unrefereed candidate excluding the specified closed two-circulant Szollosi family from MUB quadruplets in complex dimension six. The Fourier-family result re-proves prior work. The unrestricted dimension-six maximum remains conditional on MMVW Conjecture 2. The package separates an untrusted hull generator from an interval and graph checker; canonical half-open ownership repairs boundary coverage, and input-bound clean replay prevents stale cache acceptance. No end-to-end formal verification, unaffiliated reproduction or external human peer review is claimed. See the replay receipt for exact measured scope.
